title: Domestication of the llama and alpaca
summary: Llamas and alpacas were domesticated in the Andean highlands; one museum source says approximately 6000 years ago, while an encyclopedia entry dates the first alpaca domestication to after 4000 BCE, with full-time pastoralism by 3500, at sites such as Telarmachay in central highland Peru. It says both animals were available to herders by 3000-2500 BCE.

uncertainty.note: Sources differ: "approximately 6000 years ago" versus after 4000 B.C.E.; dated from the later wording with wide uncertainty.
